command_replay.rule: Run each command array as recorded. When its first item ends in .py, prefix python_interpreter; arrays already beginning with a Python executable need no prefix.

inputs.gpu_aggregation_rule: For each family and timing mode, select comparisons where control=burst and gpu_elapsed.status=ok, then report the min/max of vulkan_vs_hip_speedup.
inputs.ratio_definition: vulkan_vs_hip_speedup = HIP GPU per-iteration median / Vulkan GPU per-iteration median; values greater than 1 favor Vulkan.
inputs.source_artifact_manifest_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines '<timing_mode>\t<family>\t<artifact_sha256>\n' in comparisons array order.

interpretation: Clean timing-contract-v2 bounded matrix. Serial latency and independent throughput are separate claims. Family-wide Q4/Q6/Q8 ranges include standalone q8_1 quantization, so production transfer must use the operation-specific combined quantize-plus-dot rows. This artifact is kernel-microbenchmark evidence, not an end-to-end hipEngine inference backend claim.
notes: Only dispatch serial-latency host wall has a matched submission contract and is aggregated here; every other cross-backend host wall is unpaired and excluded.
Standalone q8_1 quantization speedups do not establish a combined quantize-plus-dot or inference win.
Independent-throughput dispatch results measure disjoint-work queue throughput and must not be compared with serial-latency launch floors.
The Q4 correctness gate is tolerance-based (KL/top-1), not bit-exact.
